evaluator_truth_policy: Only this test calls /gzserver/get_entity_state; truth is saved to local evidence and is not published or consumed by the EKF.

checks.name: raw, covariance-qualified wheel, filtered odometry and IMU received
raw and wheel streams share exact stamps for >=98% of the smaller stream
wheel velocity covariance is nonzero and pose is excluded
IMU dropout stops data, EKF continues, and input recovers
simulation clock and sensor stamps are monotonic
filtered covariance remains finite and nonnegative
known-start TF chain has required edges and no parent conflicts
filtered pose has no one-sample jumps
straight, in-place rotation, rectangle, and return are recorded
wall stall is stationary and the EKF reduces raw wheel drift
